text:
aditya: Quick heads up — apac-gpu pool (apac-a) has been at 85-95% alloc for ~8h, and we've seen 100–250ms tail latency spikes for hosted requests.

misha: Which node family? any specific hosts?

aditya: p3x-like fleet. Suspect noisy neighbors on gnode-apac-a-23 and -47. Short snippet:
```gnode-apac-a-23  GPU0  98%  pid: 4021
gnode-apac-a-47  GPU0  94%  pid: 1192
gnode-apac-a-88  GPU1  92%  pid: 880``` 

opsbot: autoscaler:scale-up triggered by apac-a at 2026-03-17T09:04:12Z, request_id=as-19807-1

claire: Are these long-running rentals (dedicated) or hosted tenants? Could be a large-batch training job sneaking in.

aditya: Looks hosted — bursts from a set of mid-tier tenants. Not user-facing OOMs, just tail latency. Eviction seen twice in last 12h.

yusuf: Can we push a quick routing rule to divert requests with tag "high_batch" to dedicated-gpu-shared1 for the next 2h? That should reduce pressure while infra investigates.

hana: I'm worried about cost if we start redistributing too much to dedicated pools. How much headroom dedicated-gpu-shared1 has?

misha: shared1 has ~15% spare, can absorb some but not all. We can also spin up short-lived burst nodes via spot, but networking in apac-region has longer provisioning time (~12-15m).

aditya: Proposal: 1) add routing rule (canary) for tenants with high_batch tag -> dedicated-gpu-shared1, 2) increase pool autoscale min by 1 node, 3) run a probe to identify repeat offenders and add rate-limit. Rollout 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m.

claire: +1 to canary. I'll own the rollout and rollback steps. Checklist: update route, monitor p99 latency, watch evictions.

opsbot: deploy-bot: routing-rule-create job queued (job_id rr-789). ETA ~30s.

aditya: Thanks. I'll create a short incident note and ping infra-oncall after the canary if tail latency doesn't drop.

hana: Also suggest we flag those tenants for cost review; repeated heavy bursters should be encouraged to choose dedicated reserved for predictable performance.

yusuf: I'll prepare a short billing-impact estimate in #finance and tag customers if needed.

claire: Rollout starting now.

opsbot: routing-rule-create succeeded rr-789 -> active (canary 20%).

aditya: seeing immediate drop in p99 on the canary subset. Will update after 20m.

misha: keeping an eye on node heat. Let me know if we need thermal throttling mitigation.

aditya: update at +20m: p99 down ~120ms on affected routes, overall apac tail reduced. Proceeding to 50%.

claire: Proceed to 100% in 10m if stable. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:
